title: WhatsApp is testing a new folder for messages from large businesses | TechCrunch
summary: At the moment, small businesses and individual accounts using WhatsApp Business are exempt from this feature. WhatsApp said it could explore moving business messages from small businesses to the new “Offers & Updates” folder in the future.
